historical_commentary.text: 4D's native XML parsing commands introduced in this era remain part of the product today and continue to be a supported way to work with XML data, so the core capability discussed here is still relevant, even though modern 4D applications more often reach for JSON parsing/generation commands for typical web integration work.
related_updates: 4D's XML parsing commands introduced around this era remain supported in current versions
JSON has become the more commonly used data format for modern web integration, though XML parsing remains available and relevant for document/legacy-integration use cases
